info.name: News Mail
info.summary: Mails each News user the new entries of their feeds, one mail per feed update, and marks them read
info.description: Each time News fetches a feed with new entries, its owner gets a mail listing them, sent from Nextcloud's own address, and the entries are marked read in News once it has gone out. Every News user with an email address gets them; there is no setting.
info.author: Parker Wahle
